## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for users? Link the issue, if any.
For routing changes, add a before/after example.

## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: ...`, `fix: ...`, `docs: ...`).
- [ ] Routing, scoring or discovery changes have tests.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes.
- [ ] `npm run test:package` passes after the build.
- [ ] `npm run docs:build` passes (guide changes).
- [ ] README, docs and Skill match any change in public behavior.
- [ ] No credentials, personal paths, or real account or task data.

Mention any check you could not run.
